hero.subheading: Full-Stack Mobile Engineer with 3+ years shipping production-grade AI and offline-first SaaS apps used by 5,000+ technicians globally. Based in Hyderabad, India.

about.heading: Engineering systems that work everywhere, always.
paragraphs: I build software that doesn't break when the internet does. My focus is on offline-first architectures, AI-powered tooling, and mobile systems that serve field technicians in environments where reliability isn't optional , it's the product.

At Innovapptive, I've shipped AI engines that cut RCA resolution time by 47%, sync systems that run 2.5× faster, and mobile apps used daily by 5,000+ technicians across enterprise deployments. I care deeply about measurable impact, not just clean code.

experience.subtitle: AI & SaaS Systems

items.title: AI-Powered Root Cause Analysis Engine
items.problem: Enterprise technicians spent hours manually diagnosing equipment failures with no intelligent assistance.
items.solution: Built an LLM-based RCA engine that traverses a Neo4j knowledge graph to surface root causes and suggest fixes in real time.
items.impact: 47% faster resolution time in production. Used by 5,000+ technicians daily.

items.title: Real-Time Offline Sync System
items.problem: Field technicians lost data and productivity when working in areas with no internet connectivity.
items.solution: Engineered a peer-to-peer sync architecture using Ditto SDK + Realm with conflict resolution and zero-downtime guarantees.
items.impact: 2.5× faster sync, 70% fewer sync failures, 100% data reliability in offline environments.

items.title: Construction Project Management Platform
items.problem: Construction teams across 100+ sites had no unified platform for real-time task coordination.
items.solution: Built a full-stack platform with React Native + Node.js + GraphQL enabling real-time collaboration, file sharing, and progress tracking.
items.impact: 30% reduction in project delays. Adopted by 100+ technicians across enterprise deployments.

items.title: Offline OCR Document Pipeline
items.problem: Technicians needed to digitize paper-based work orders in the field without internet access.
items.solution: Built an on-device OCR pipeline using TensorFlow Lite + Tesseract that processes documents entirely offline.
items.impact: 92% OCR accuracy on-device. 60% reduction in manual data entry time.
